Cell.Data: Be sure to revisit ports and buildings now and again - you never know when a new opportunity may present itself...
As you know, <player>, prices at markets and shops fluctuate based on local supply and demand, season, tastes and special conditions.
If you choose to haggle, make sure that what you are saying is appropriate to the situation at hand.
The market is finicky, <player>. Make sure you keep your offerings fresh, or you'll see your profits take a dive.
Be careful around here, <player>. Not everyone you come across is to be trusted.
There sure seems to be plenty of opportunity for entrepreneurs these days.
The more chocolate I eat, the more I seem to crave it.
There is nothing like a good, strong cup of coffee to get the day started off on the right foot.
You'd be wise to make sure that you're continually introducing new confections into the market. Consumers love new things, and are willing to pay for them.
I've been hearing really good things about your confections, <player>.
Remember, <player>, fresh ingredients won't last forever. If they sit unused in your inventory for too long, they will eventually spoil.
A smart businessperson always keeps an eye on the calendar. Local holidays and festivals can drastically change what people are willing to pay for sweets.
Every customer has their own unique tastes and preferences. If you pay close attention to what they like, you'll be much more successful in fulfilling their requests.
Once you own a shop, don't forget to check in with your clerks regularly. You never know when a highly profitable commissioned order might be waiting for you.

Make chocolates as often as you like, but keep in mind that each factory run takes up a week that you could spend sourcing new ingredients, selling confections, and charting new paths for your business...
An idle factory is a drain on your finances, <player>. Always ensure you have enough supplies on hand to keep production moving while you travel.
The classics are wonderful, of course, but the world is changing rapidly. Don't be afraid to experiment with bold new flavor combinations.

Certain ingredients are seasonal. This means that you'll find dramatically better pricing for these goods when they're in season. You'll still be able to get a hold of them out of season, but you'll pay a lot of scratch for the privilege.
You'll only find cacao growing in the "twenty-twenty" zone - a narrow band between 20 degrees North and 20 degrees South of the Equator.
It is truly a marvel how a simple cacao bean can be transformed into so many different luxuries.
I am sure excited about coffee, <player>. I hope you are too!
Ahh, Japan is just beautiful this time of year!
So you're the one they've got making decisions over at Baumeister Confections, eh?
There are forces at play, <player>, beyond your understanding, and beyond your ability to control.
When things are going well, they go well. But when they go bad, they can go really bad.
Click on an ingredient to buy some.
Welcome to {building}. How may I assist you today?
Good to see you again. Let me know if you need help finding anything in particular.
Welcome back! Please step inside and review my prices.
Good day to you, <player>. Please, browse the inventory at your leisure.
Click on any ingredient sack to check our current market prices.
Are you sourcing for Baumeister Confections today? I have everything you need right here.
Welcome back to {port}. Looking to restock your factories?
So, you are the one making waves in the chocolate world. Alex sent word you might come. I am %bal_marketkeep%. Welcome to our island!
Welcome, welcome! Come in out of the sun. It is a hot one today, eh?
Ah, the traveler returns. You are looking for spices? Fruit? I have the best on the island right here.
Smile, <player>! You are in %bali%. We do business here, but we do not rush.
Welcome to Agung Shadows, <player>. Make yourself comfortable. Business is better when we are both smiling, yes?
Selamat siang! Come, smell all of these beautiful spices.
I saw you coming from the dock. Your ship rides low in the water. You must have a lot of money to spend, eh?
My stall felt too quiet without you, my friend. Tell me, what do you need?
Happy New Year! A new calendar, a new cycle. Let us start it with a good transaction, yes?
Love is in the air! Or maybe that is just the cloves. Otherwise, I can help.
Shh. Soon is Nyepi. The whole island will be silent to fool the spirits into thinking no one is home. But today... we make noise. We trade!
I hear you celebrate the big holiday soon. The day of gifts. I have gifts here... nutmeg, cinnamon... better than socks, I think.
<player>, it is good to see your face again. Did your travels treat you well?
Ah, hey! The market is loud, but for you I always have a minute.
Welcome back to the %dou_market%, <player>. Come, have a look.
The sun is strong today, eh? Come stand in the shade of my stall.
Good, a friendly face. I've been dealing with hagglers all morning. What can I help you find?
Hello, my chocolatier friend. Tell me what you need, and don't waste your wings flying around the world for worse prices than mine, eh?
Back so soon, <player>? Your factories must be running fast! I like that kind of efficiency.
You sure must love my ingredients, don't you, <player>?
You're making those %i04% for Mrs. Siqueira over at the hotel here in town, <player>, right? I have the %cayenne% and the %anise% you need right here.
Word travels fast in this market! You must be here for my %vanilla% to use in that new recipe you got from Japan, eh?
Good to see you! Ilan at the port in Morocco sent word you might be coming. He said you have a special recipe that needs some sweet Mangoes.
Aloha, <player>. Let me know if you need anything.
Welcome. The good stuff's right here. Sun's hot today, yeah?
Long trip? You look like you could use a break. Anyway, you know where everything is.
Hey, you're back. Need to restock?
Hey there. See anything you like, just give me a shout.
You looking for ingredients? You're in the right place.
Oh! Hello. I didn't see you come in. Can I help you find something?
Welcome back to %toronto%. It's... it's really nice to see a familiar face.
Is there something specific you needed? I can check the back room if the shelves are empty.
Then let us begin. Treat this harvest with respect, and we will have no problems. What do you need?
You must be here for the %lime%.
The air is dry today. The %lime% are sharp.
Our Country provides. What will you take?
Don't stand around. If you're buying, buy.
You're back. Good. The new harvest is in.
Welcome, <player>. Come in, come in. What do you need today to keep the Baumeister machines running?
It is good to see your face again. My shelves are stocked and ready for you.
Guten Tag, <player>. How can I assist you?
Ah, <player>. Good to see a friendly face. How can I help?
Good day, <player>. What do you need today?
You look exhausted. Have you been sleeping on those long flights? Please, take your time browsing today.
Welcome back to the cobbled streets, <player>. It is always a comfort to see your plane touch down safely.
Grüezi, <player>! The air is crisp today, isn't it?
Love is warming the chilly air today! Are you buying ingredients for a special someone, or just to feed the romance of the city?
Frohe Ostern! The whole city is craving sugar today, so you had best buy your supplies before my shelves are empty!
Fröhliche Weihnachten, <player>! The market is so beautiful with the snow and the lights. Are you here for holiday baking supplies?
Those will be {price} each. Thank you.
Done. Anything else catching your eye?
I'll pack those {item} up right away. What else did you need?
I will have the invoice printed and these prepared for transport immediately, <player>.
All done. Just click another sack if you need something else.
It is good to do business with you, <player>.
A pleasure doing business with a reasonable person. Thank you for your purchase.
See? I'm glad we could work out a deal that benefits us both.
I'm happy that we could come to an agreement. Enjoy the ingredients!
It's always nice to reach a compromise that leaves both parties smiling. I'll pack these {item} up for you right away.
A wonderfully smooth transaction. I hope these {item} serve Baumeister Confections well!
I'm glad I was able to pass along a discount to a customer who knows the true art of negotiation. Safe travels, friend.
I'll update the invoice with our new price. Do you need anything else today?
You certainly know how to talk a merchant down, <player>. Use these supplies well!
Thanks. But next time, you'll recognize a fair price when you see one.
Fine. Thank you for your purchase, I suppose.
Yes, yes, the deal is done. A pleasure, I'm sure.
I suggest you practice your negotiating skills before your next visit to not just {building}, but any kind of market.
You actually paid the penalty rate? Well, I certainly appreciate the extra profit for my stall.
Let us hope you bring better manners next time...
That was thoroughly exhausting. I probably won't live that negotiation down.
So, you still bought these {item} after the price hike. I guess you really needed them.
Terima kasih! May your journey be smooth.
Good, good! I will be here when you need more, <player>.
The spirits are smiling on this transaction. Be well.
Ah, nice choice. Those are very fresh.
A sound trade. Go now, create something delightful.
A good trade makes the food taste better, don't you think?
Treat these ingredients with respect, and they will make you rich, <player>.
Good. Now I have money, and you have the best goods in the Indies. We are both winners.
You want more cacao? Good. Santoso up at the plantation thinks he is the only one with beans, but mine are just as good.
The cloves are strong this year. They will numb your tongue if you are not careful!
The tree of life! We use the wood, the leaves, the oil... nothing is wasted here.
Ah, the seed of the Myristica! A king's spice. You have chosen well.
Use those quickly! They are sweet like honey, but they are messy. Do not ruin your nice suit.
The mangoes are in prime seasonality today. Later? Maybe too soft. But today... perfection.
Juice running down the chin... that is the only way to eat a mango in season.
Good for the body, is it not? But wash your hands after you touch it, or you will have yellow fingers for a week!
These will treat you well. I don't bother stocking anything less.
All done. Take care on your way through %douala%, you hear?
You know where to find me when you need more.
Thank you. Watch yourself in the crowd on the way out, it gets busy.
Thanks for bringing your business here, <player>. My family and suppliers really appreciate it.
There we are, <player>. Anything else while you're here?
Ah, the anise! Its sweet spice will be perfect for Mrs. Siqueira's recipe. I hope she knows how much work goes into what you make for her.
Those peppers have a good, steady heat. Don't be shy with them - that recipe needs a little fire to wake it up.
That's proper cinnamon, not the dry bark some people sell tourists. It'll sit nicely beside your %vanilla%.
There you go. That vanilla travelled far to reach %douala%, but one breath of the aroma tells you it was worth it, eh?
Here you are. These mangoes are for Ilan's recipe then? Tell him Tomge's still keeping him honest - and that he still owes me for that last spice shipment.
See? We talk like people, and we both walk away smiling. I like doing business with you, <player>.
You understand value, not just numbers. Thank you, my friend.
Remember: a bit of kindness costs nothing. Next time, try talking with me, not at me.
We're done for today. Just keep in mind this stall stands on respect, not shouting. Okay?
Next time, let's speak to each other like friends again, eh?
Right on. This should serve you well.
Good choice. This stuff's the real deal.
Alright then. Let me know how that batch turns out.
You need anything else, <player>, you just let me know.
You can't leave Hawaii without mac nuts. It's like... against the law or something. Enjoy 'em.
Thanks! I'll make sure these get loaded onto your transport carefully.
Have a safe trip! Come back soon.
Okay, all done. Do you need a receipt for your records?
Thanks, <player>. It was nice talking to you.
You have good taste, <player>! It really is the icon of Canadian food.
It's the real Grade A syrup from Québec. My grandmother says the darker syrup has more flavor to it.
I just wiped down all the maple syrup jugs, so they shouldn't be sticky. If that helps?
There should be some paperwork to sign for buying alcohol around here. Just put your name and signature down when you're ready.
That's... quite a strong rye. Please be careful with the bottle on your way out.
These sugar sacks weigh a fair bit. I... I can't lift them myself, but I can point out which pallet is the freshest.
Please be quick with the %milk%! The refrigeration unit is acting up again and I'm terrified it's going to spoil on my shift.
The classic milk-run, I see? We sell these at the speed of light, I tell you.
This cream came from the dairy farms in Guelph this morning. Should work perfectly for all the good stuff you'll be creating.
The cream is very rich today. I checked the dates myself this morning, so I know it's good.
These pecans are expensive imports, so I have to weigh them out firmly. No snacking, sorry... store policy.
Be careful with the raspberry sacks. They bruise so easily, and the boss doesn't appreciate it when the juice stains the floor.
Low-bush blueberries, these ones. I spent all morning sorting out the stems, so they should be ready for your factory immediately.
These just came in from the north. My fingers are still a little blue from sorting them! Use them in good health.
I kept this butter in the back of the cooler where it's coldest. It should hold up for your trip.
The toffee bits are pre-crushed. It saves a lot of time. I used to have to smash them with a hammer in the back room - it was loud.
Don't chip a tooth on that toffee! It's very hard.
Ontario Northern Spies. Best apples in the world, honestly.
I picked out the shiny ones for you. They smell wonderful, don't they? Like crisp autumn air.
Your hands might get purple if you touch these. Here, let me wrap the sacks in paper for you.
This is local clover honey. It crystallizes if it gets too cold, so keep it at room temperature.
These beans smell amazing, don't they? I'm not allowed to drink the inventory, but sometimes I just stand here and smell the burlap sacks.
Wow, these beans smell strong. The whole shop is going to smell like coffee for the rest of the afternoon.
Cashews are really popular lately. I've had to restock this bin three times today already. My arms are tired, haha!
Mr. Tangye - sorry, "Joseph" - usually asks for these specifically for the Blends factory. I hope you aren't taking his stash!
These are good walnuts. My grandmother used to put these in her loaves. I hope you make something just as nice with them.
Okay, it's done. I'll just... put this receipt at the bottom of the pile so he doesn't see it right away.
Thank you. Please, just... take the supplies quickly?
Phew. Okay. I hope you put those ingredients to good use.
Oh, thank you for understanding. You have no idea how much trouble I'd be in if I changed those numbers.
I really appreciate you paying the sticker price. It makes my inventory count so much easier at the end of the day.
Thank you. I know it's expensive, but the quality is really good. I packed the bags myself.
Don't waste them. They're good this season.
That's all. Watch yourself on the roads.
I trust you're making something worthwhile with these.
Done. Now, get out of my sight.
Thank you for your business. May these bring you good fortune.
Anything else I can help you with, young one?
May these ingredients serve you well. Go on now, make something wonderful.
There you go, my dear. Safe travels, and do come back and visit an old woman soon, yes?
You have a safe flight now, <player>.
Everything is packed and ready for the factory. Give my best to the rest of the Baumeisters!
These almonds are wonderful for a classic crunch. Analiese at the chocolate shop across the way simply loves a good almond bar, you know.
A sophisticated choice! A splash of amaretto warms the soul on these chilly Swiss evenings.
Be careful carrying that caramel to the factory, it is very fresh and the jars can be quite warm.
Excellent choice. Analiese at the shop always says your caramel chocolates are the ones that disappear the fastest.
These Bing cherries are beautiful right now. They will make a very romantic confection, I am sure of it.
Just a pinch of those cloves, remember! They are very potent this season.
A very comforting spice. I always keep cloves in my pantry to brew in my tea when the winter flu goes around the city.
Just promise me you won't grind these beans all yourself to stay awake. You need your rest, <player>!
Ah, the Grand Marnier. The orange aroma on this liqueur is quite luxurious.
The bees have been very busy this season, <player>! I can guarantee you that.
This honey comes from the wildflowers up in the Alps. It is so thick and golden. It will keep your ganaches beautifully soft.
You have picked well, <player>. These lemons arrived from the Mediterranean just this morning.
The zest is notably fragrant. Do be careful not to overpower your cacao with them!
The Alpine dairy farmers worked hard for this batch! Use it well.
Bright, sweet oranges. A little slice of sunshine to take with you into the factory.
Treat these edible rose petals delicately, <player>. They were hand-picked and sugared just yesterday by our local artisans.
Those rose petals are a very romantic choice. I am sure whatever you create with them will be absolutely exquisite.
A Baumeister always needs sugar! I swear, I order more sacks for you than for the rest of Zürich's bakers combined.
So much sugar! Your machines will be humming all night.
Ah, walnuts. They remind me of the dense nut cakes my grandmother used to bake in the winters. Treat them well!
A little drop of whiskey for the chocolates... or perhaps a drop for the chocolatier? Do not worry, your secret is safe with me.
Oh my, the whiskey! That will add quite the sophisticated warmth to your confections.
Here's what I am willing to pay for your items.
Welcome to {building}. Here are the prices I have on offer for your goods.
Good day to you, <player>. Are you looking to sell to us?
My customers are always eager for Baumeister Confections products. Let us see what you have brought.
Greetings. I have capital ready to invest if you have the right products to sell.
Good to see you again. Please, step inside and show me what you are selling.
Hello there. Care to show me your latest confections?
I'm glad to see a Baumeister representative in my shop. Shall we review your inventory?
Welcome back to your shop! Here's the premium pricing I can offer.
Welcome back to {port}, <player>! As the owner, you'll receive the absolute best margins we can offer.
Good to see the boss again! We've prepared the price ledgers for your arrival, <player>.
The shelves have been cleared for your goods as always, <player>. Let's see the confections you have brought for us...
Welcome back to your shop, <player>. It is always a pleasure to see you again...
{building} is your shop, <player>. How can we be of service?
Hello, boss. I trust all is well with you?
Always a pleasure to see the owner of {building} walk through those doors. How can I help you restock us today, <player>?
Welcome... I am Kefilwe. I am helping the master today. He told me that if the Baumeister representative arrives, I must be very helpful. Please, may I see what you have brought for us?
Welcome! I have cleared space in the display case. How can we do business today?
Mholo, <player>! Is it time for a new delivery?
Welcome back! My boss is in the back rooms, but he told me I could look after you as always.
Ah, it is a blessing to see you! Please, show me your confections.
Aloha! Welcome to {port}. I'm {merchant}, and I manage {building}. We're always looking for new chocolates to show our visitors!
Ah, <player>. Step in out of that dreadful Medina heat, please. What have you brought me?
My esteemed business associate, welcome. I trust your travels were smooth?
Excellent timing. Shall we get down to business?
Velkominn, <player>! So glad you stopped by.
You've come to the right place. Let me know what you're selling today.
Hey there! Let's see what you've got for me.
Come on in, <player>. Please make yourself warm. Anything I can help you with?
Ah, you're back! The shop was starting to feel a little empty without your creations.

Hey, you're the new operator from Baumeister, right? Heard Whitney was putting her faith in you. Well, I'm Karolyne. I sell the quirky stuff in here, and I tell you, I'm seriously interested in those %exotic% I'm hearing rumors of.
Right, you're back. Don't waste my time with the boring stuff unless you have to. Show me something new!
Thank goodness, a delivery! I was about to die of boredom. What have you brought me? Anything interesting?
Finally! Someone who doesn't just want to talk about the weather. Let's do business.
Hey, <player>! My shelves are a bit bare. What have you got for %wel_shop%?
Okay, hit me. What new, brilliant, possibly unsellable thing have you and Whitney cooked up this time? I'm ready.
Welcome to %wel_shop%. Official greeting over. Now then, are you selling anything today?
Grüezi, <player>! It is always a comfort to see my very first supplier walk through those doors.
Welcome back, my friend. The neighborhood has been asking for your chocolates all week. Let us see what fine quality goods you have to offer us today.
Ah, <player>. I was just adjusting the displays. I always make sure to leave the premier shelf space for Baumeister Confections. Shall we review your inventory?
Hi there! How is my favorite chocolatier today?
Guten Tag, <player>! It remains a privilege to do business with you. What are we trading today?
I am glad to see you again. What Baumeister classics have you brought to Niederdorf Chocolates today?
Thanks for doing business with us!
I have transferred {total_price} to your account. Come back to {building} soon!
These {item} should sell very well here. Thank you!
It is always a pleasure doing business with Baumeister Confections, <player>.
These will surely please our clientele. Are you selling any other goods today?
Excellent! I'll get these {item} into the display cases at my earliest convenience.
All sorted. Just click another product below if you wish to make an additional transaction.
I'm glad we could come to a better arrangement. It's a pleasure doing business with you!
Excellent. This is how business should be done.
It's good that we could work out a deal. These will sell nicely!
A pleasure, as always. It's good to work with someone so savvy.
I am paying top dollar today, but for Baumeister quality, it is worth every penny. Thank you!
We work well together, <player>. I look forward to many more mutually beneficial arrangements in the future!
Now, here's hoping these {item} sell out fast and furious! We'll want to profit from this exchange, too.
The ledger has been updated with our agreed-upon price. Have a wonderful day, and safe travels, <player>.
Hm. I thought you were going to walk away. Well, pleasure doing business with you.
So you decided to sell after all. Thank you for the goods.
I'll take them. But I'm not happy about how our negotiation went.
Yes, yes, the deal is done. A pleasure, I'm sure.
I am genuinely surprised you were still willing to sell them for so little. But a deal is a deal.
Well, that certainly could have gone smoother...
Now, if you'll excuse me, I have more agreeable clients waiting.
You left quite a bit of profit on the table today. Perhaps you'll bring a cooler head the next time you have something to sell.
Oh, these are beautiful! I will handle these very carefully, I promise.
My uncle says that kindness always returns to those who give it. Safe travels on your big plane!
Enkosi, thank you! The money will go into your account, and these beautiful chocolates will go straight into the window.
I am so glad we could agree. Your kindness means a lot to me, <player>.
You have been so generous. I will write this in the book with a happy hand.
Here is the money. I will put the sweets away now.
I pray that our next meeting is a happier one.
Okay, thank you. I... I think I need a moment to collect myself before the next customer comes in.
A very sensible transaction. I'll have my clerks move these into the display cases immediately.
Excellent doing business with you, as always.
The {total_price} has been routed to your account, <player>. Thank you.
These {item} will move fast. The expats here have an insatiable appetite for the finer things.
Please do keep up the good work, <player>.
Do be careful carrying that much capital through the souks on your way back to the harbor, won't you? It's a den of thieves out there.
Splendid. These will do quite nicely to elevate the palate of our local clientele.
Done and dusted. Do send my regards to my sister when you next speak to her.
I'll enjoy rubbing this successful quarter in Alex's face the next time she wires me...
It's a pleasure dealing with someone who understands the art of the deal, <player>.
An excellent compromise. I look forward to our next negotiation.
I am glad we could reach a mutually beneficial arrangement. Good business, <player>.
Very well. A higher disbursement for you, but I assure you, I will still turn a tidy profit on these regardless.
Let's just... consider this a lesson in market economics.
To be frank, <player>? I do expect a much better negotiation from a Baumeister CEO. That was just brute-forcing.
I will authorize this deal, but I find your negotiation tactics to be exceedingly vulgar.
It is a pity we had to resort to such bazaar-style bickering just to end up here. Do try to find some dignity before your next visit.
I am... perplexed. You attempted to squeeze my margins, failed quite publicly, and yet you still decided to proceed with the sale at my lower rate? Very well, then...
Let's put this messy transaction behind us and focus on the future.
Always a pleasure doing business with you. Safe travels out there!
Thanks for the great products, <player>. Anything else?
Perfect! My customers are going to love this.
Great! This will fly off the shelves. Let me know if there's anything else I can do for you today.
Excellent transaction. Fast, efficient, and now I have something interesting to sell. Wish all my suppliers were like you.
Done. Now I just have to figure out how to describe these {item} to someone. That's the fun part.
My shelves look more interesting already. Thanks, <player>.
Right, that's sorted. My customers will be happy. Or at least intrigued. Same thing.
Perfect! This will definitely get people talking.
The first batch of {item} in the entire world, right here in my shop? Oh, this is going to be fun. The other shopkeepers are going to be so jealous.
Hold on. No one else has sold this yet? You brought your brand new {item} to me first? Ha! I knew you were smart.
Wait, you're giving us your first ever {item}? YES! This is what I live for!
Oh, %b01%. The essentials. Fine, I'll buy them, but this isn't what gets my blood pumping, you know?
Right, the %b01%. They'll sell, they always do. It pays the bills. Thanks, I guess.
Oh, %b02%. The essentials. Fine, I'll buy them, but this isn't what gets my blood pumping, you know?
Right, the %b02%. They'll sell, they always do. It pays the bills. Thanks, I guess.
Yeah, I'm glad I'm giving top dollar to goods like yours I love to bits.
Glad to help you, <player>. I did have plenty of cash to spare after all.
I'll take them. But that was a painful conversation.
Weird. Now I got more money to save thanks to that failed negotiation. I kinda don't regret this...?
Look, I'll take them because I need the stock, but don't try that nonsense again. My first offer was fair.
Excellent. It is reliable partnerships like ours that keep this city moving forward.
Thank you, <player>. I will see you on your next visit.
A seamless transaction, as always. Thank you for helping me bring a little sweetness to the streets of %zurich% today.
Danke, <player>. These won't stay on my shelves for long!
Evangeline would be proud of the standards you are upholding. Thank you, <player>.
Much appreciated, <player>. Do you have anything else to share with us?
A thoroughly professional negotiation. I look forward to our next arrangement, <player>.
It is always a pleasure to reach an agreement that benefits us both. Danke.
I will process the transaction, but I expect a smoother negotiation next time we meet.
The paperwork is complete. Let us hope our next meeting is a bit more agreeable, yes?
I'm always looking for products to stock my shelves. Come back when you have something to sell!
You don't appear to have anything to sell, but come back when you do. We're always looking for new products and will be happy to purchase anything you have to offer for sale at a reasonable price.
It seems your cargo hold is empty right now. Our customers are always thrilled to see Baumeister Confections on our shelves, so please come back as soon as you have more goods to trade.
Hello, <player>. You are always welcome at {building}, of course, but do let me know when you have some fresh chocolates or coffees ready to sell.
Nothing to sell today? Take your time. We will be right here when you are ready.

It looks like you're traveling light today, <player>. Whenever your factories have produced a new batch of confections, you know where to find {building}. Our customers are always eager for Baumeister quality!

My shelves are cleared and waiting, but it appears you don't have any products to offer just now. When you have finished goods to trade, I will be here ready to offer you a mutually beneficial arrangement.
Just making a social call today? I must admit I was hoping to see some of your famous chocolates or coffees. Let's do business next time you're in {port}.
Oh, you have nothing today? That is okay, <player>. You are always welcome to rest your feet here.
Hello again. The display cases are still a bit empty, but I will keep them clean and shining for when you return with your sweets!
You are traveling light today! Do not worry yourself, <player>. The walk from the docks is steep, so please, sit and catch your breath.
Ah, empty hands! That is alright. It is quiet in the shop today...
Nothing to sell? Oh, the regulars will be disappointed! But I will tell them you are working very hard. I am only a block or so away from the Mr. Felix's factory, so I know a delivery is coming soon!
You know, <player>, walking into a retail establishment without inventory is a remarkably poor use of your logistical overhead. I'll overlook it this once, but time is money!
I suppose even the most efficient supply chains experience the occasional hiccup. Do return when your cargo hold is full.
Just a social call? Very well. Let me know when you're ready to do actual business.

Alex must have you running ragged if you don't even have time to stock your own cargo hold, but you are always welcome to enjoy the shade and a cup of our house blend. Get back to the factories soon, would you?
I appreciate a social visit as much as the next guy, <player>, but this is prime retail real estate. Come back when you have something that affects my bottom line.
Just browsing, are we? I certainly hope you aren't picking up my sister's habit of dramatic pauses. When you actually have goods to trade, you know where my desk is.
